purpose: Supplementary direct FrameTiming API before/after comparison over the same logical 30..90 second workload as the formal 20-run measurement. Formal 20-run evidence is preserved separately.
environment: Unity 6000.3.27f1, Android-selected Windows Editor, Domain Reload OFF. Parent controls all Editor/source transitions and restores original environment.
identity: Original 137 sources are verified against the original baseline manifest; 3 new product files and 4 directly dependent test files are temporarily excluded from compilation by the parent. Final product source and 26 exact bytes/meta backups are verified on restoration.

units.profilerDurations: TimeNanoseconds, converted to milliseconds during analysis
units.frameTimingApi: milliseconds, already converted by Unity API

frameTiming: Require feature enabled, 3600 fresh nonzero strictly increasing frame timestamps and finite positive CPU fields. Returned timings are delayed captured frames, not necessarily the current logical command.
limitations: No ad-hoc RenderLoop subtraction or missing-counter imputation.
No GC allocation-location evidence is collected by this diagnostic.
Only basic and heavy workloads are diagnosed.
